transcript.answer: Lore's own Floor engine (apps/floor) was deleted on 2026-10-02 (PR #2431, commit ca031776d, per specs/external-floor FR16). The external Floor replaced it. This is the rewritten standalone engine, re-cinq/floor, which runs in the same cluster as Lore. Lore reaches it only through @re-cinq/floor-client, and ADR-049 describes the move onto it, done one family of assembly lines at a time. The old line files, detectors and fallbacks were cleaned up afterwards in PR #2454.
